verdict.rationale: FreeAgent documents a REST API with OAuth 2.0, a sandbox environment and curl usage, but nothing in the evidence mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. An API alone is a developer building block, not an SDK. Official SDKs are a fair ask for a SaaS platform with a public API, so this is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
